Label: Description
Value: A weekly dataset providing the total number of reported political violence, civilian-targeting, and demonstration events in Iran. Note: These are aggregated data files organized by country-year and country-month. To access full event data, please register to use the Data Export Tool and API on the ACLED website.

Label: Description
Value: A weekly dataset providing the total number of reported political violence events and fatalities in Iran broken down by month. Political violence events include ACLED’s battles, violence against civilians, and explosions/remote violence event types, as well as the mob violence sub-event type of the riots event type.

Label: Description
Value: A weekly dataset providing the total number of reported civilian targeting events and fatalities in Iran broken down by month. Civilian targeting events include violence against civilians events and explosions/remote violence events in which civilians were directly targeted.

Label: Description
Value: A weekly dataset providing the total number of reported demonstration events in Iran broken down by month. Demonstration events include ACLED’s protests and riots event types, with the exception of the mob violence sub-event type of the riots event type.
